latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of openclaw-update-researcher.
- Automates research on the latest OpenClaw updates by collecting and filtering GitHub Release/Tag information.
- Focuses on updates from the previous day (Asia/Shanghai timezone).
- Highlights and analyzes changes related to memory systems (memory, embeddings, lancedb, sqlite).
- Generates structured Markdown reports, including version, date, update type, and a dedicated memory section when applicable.
- Provides a direct GitHub Release link in each report.
